verdict.rationale: Paxos documents creating deposit addresses (in the context of on-chain transfers in Sandbox) and creating fiat deposit instructions, which are the building pieces of attributable inbound funds. The evidence never shows these being issued per customer or per identity, or that inbound transfers are automatically tagged to a customer for reconciliation. Missing for 10: explicit per-customer deposit addresses or virtual accounts tied to identities, documented automatic attribution of incoming wires and on-chain deposits to a customer, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, incoming funds are attributable — named virtual accounts or dedicated deposit addresses per customer so reconciliation knows who paid without manual matching

citations.quote: When you create a deposit address in Sandbox, the generated address can be used to transfer test assets from a testnet or devnet wallet to the Paxos platform.
Reconcile transactions on the Paxos Platform.
